trap.label: dados e verbo
trap.wrong: It is estimated that four in ten shelters is full.
trap.right: It is estimated that four in ten shelters are full.
trap.why: Em português “quatro em cada dez abrigos está/estão cheios” oscila. Em inglês, four in ten + plural leva verbo no plural.

mcq.q: It is ___ that four in ten shelters are full.
___ collected over three years, the figures are solid.

fix.wrong: Four in ten shelters is full.
fix.right: Four in ten shelters are full.

fix.wrong: It is estimate that rents rose.
fix.right: It is estimated that rents rose.

fix.wrong: Having collect over three years, the figures are solid.
fix.right: Having been collected over three years, the figures are solid.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Analysts report that rents rose.” (It is…)
rewrite.answer: It is reported that rents rose.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Staff collected the figures over a year.” (Having been…, the figures…) use are reliable
rewrite.answer: Having been collected over a year, the figures are reliable.
